feature: One commander image — the thumb renders
note: The other leaf of the same round. `ArtWash` covers every band; these three surfaces draw a commander at thumb size instead, and five renders converged on the two boxes `CommanderThumb` owns. Separate inventory because `check:shared` takes one binding, and a row whose view renders a different leaf would have to be dropped rather than checked. The partner row photographs the slot's empty plate: reaching its FILLED render needs pairing mode entered and a partner chosen, which these steps do not do. Said plainly rather than counted as coverage of a render nobody looked at — `check:shared` still proves that file renders the shared thumb, which is the half a picture cannot answer.
